intro: Designed for smaller rooms, the Adriana single bed brings together sturdy metal and sleek prelaminated board for you to enjoy a durable, stylish, and space-saving sleep solution.

features.title: Sturdy metal and board structure
features.text: The durable metal frame and 18 mm prelaminated board offer long-lasting strength and practical everyday use.

features.title: Decorative trims for a polished look
features.text: Refined down to the details. Decorative HDF trims add a polished finish, giving your furniture a sophisticated look.

features.title: Understorage for added flexibility
features.text: Keep your space clutter-free—under-bed storage makes organising a breeze and keeps essentials close at hand.

features.title: Compact design perfect for small spaces
features.text: Compact doesn’t mean compromising—perfect for hostels, PGs, or small rooms, it adds comfort and style.

features.title: Knockdown construction for easy assembly
features.text: Moving day just got easier—the knockdown construction ensures hassle-free transportation and simple assembly.

name: Adriana Single Size Engineered Wood Bed
